concepts.name: 白发脉冲
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original human-like walking character concept for the oneBeat cast.
Input image roles: Images 1, 2, 3 are authoritative existing-cast STYLE AND PROPORTION references only (lilroll, mismatch, wave). Do not edit those images or simply recolor their characters.
Primary request: create a new character who clearly looks HUMAN, with a normal human head, hair, ears, arms, hands and legs. Unusual skin color is allowed. Personality should be cool, aloof, quietly rebellious and a little quirky-cute, like the deadpan skater and striped kid, NOT a smiling mascot.
Expression priority: narrowed half-lidded eyes, heavy straight upper eyelid strokes and subtly angled brows communicate relaxed confidence and an unimpressed side glance. Keep face and eyes unobstructed. NO smile, grin, cheerful open eyes, sparkling eyes, cutesy blush, tongue, glasses or eye-covering accessories. No visible mouth unless the individual concept explicitly requests one. Cool expression is more important than accessories.
Style: match this specific cast's hand-inked 2D comic character style: slightly oversized human head but not baby chibi, natural stylized lanky-to-compact human limbs, bold organic black exterior contours, thinner interior linework, sparse directional hatch shading and distinct flat cel-shadow shapes. Well-observed streetwear folds, solid chunky footwear. Avoid realistic portraits, generic shiny anime, thin stick figures, smooth corporate vector art, soft 3D toys and overly rendered comic superheroes.
Framing/pose: exactly ONE complete full-body figure in a relaxed confident walking stride toward screen-right, near-profile with a slight three-quarter turn of the face so the cool eyes are readable. STRICTLY EYE-LEVEL camera, no looking down or looking up, no overhead top view, no dramatic foreshortening. Full shoes and hair visible with comfortable margins. Square canvas. Keep pose practical for a later walking animation.
Output/background: genuine transparent PNG alpha; character plus a small charcoal semitransparent ground contact shadow under the planted foot and lighter projection below the lifted shoe. No street scene, floor strip, backdrop, checkerboard baked into pixels, extra people, concept-sheet panels, text, slogans, logos, watermark or border.

Character 1: slender masculine human street kid with warm burnt-coral/orange skin, short chalk-white sharply chopped hair, a little asymmetrical upward cowlick and a subtle close-cut side. Small simple human ears, normal rounded/angular human face. Both eyes narrow and half-lidded, one brow slightly raised in a cool unimpressed look; omit the mouth entirely, tiny nose profile only. An oversized cropped ivory racing/bomber jacket with black shoulder and sleeve panels and a restrained teal seam accent, worn open over a plain charcoal shirt, loose black knee-length athletic shorts, ivory ribbed crew socks and chunky steel-blue/ivory sneakers with small coral accents. NO cap, helmet, striped sweater, yellow overalls or hairstyle copied from the references. Walking with one hand in a jacket pocket and the other arm swinging loosely behind; long easy stride, relaxed shoulders. Strong chalk-white hair/coral skin/black-and-ivory silhouette. Slightly odd proportions remain charming but unmistakably human, no pointy alien ears.
